title: Hall without a name on the plan
subtitle: two-storey hall at the back of the maze · Xiyang Lou

model.line: Simple massing of a European palace: position and footprint from the ruin, the plan or a survey, heights read from the plates of the 1780s (research/xiyanglou/boxes.csv). Not a detailed model yet; the figures and their methods are in the Dimensions block.
rows: two-storey hall at the back of the maze
platform 0.5 m, eave 6.5 m, ridge 9 m above the ground
by the stone kit: base, pilasters, arched openings, entablature, balustrade and a glazed roof, as the plates of the 1780s show such fronts; the kit's reading, C, not a detailed model

searched: This block has no name on the plan or in the texts, so no source can be searched for it by name.
